collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: The smell of roasting breadfruit drifts across the village.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: The smell of roasting breadfruit drifts across the village. Several villagers find reasons to walk past the cooking fire.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: The smell of roasting breadfruit drifts across the village. A child follows the smell all the way to the source.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: The smell of roasting breadfruit drifts across the village. The cook pretends not to notice how many people are suddenly hungry.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: The smell of roasting breadfruit drifts across the village. Everyone gets a slice, and nobody complains about the burnt edges.
